notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed some typos and text errors
[*]Fixed a bug where you could cast and cancel the coin skill at the same time, causing the game to soft lock
[/list]

We are still looking and trying to fix some bugs, if you found any, feel free to post it in the community hub!
